chunks: 2452 - Al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام said to one of his companions: “Do you come to the grave of Abū ʿAbd Allāh, may the blessings of Allah be upon him?”
He replied to him, “Yes.” He said: “Do you make provisions for that?” He said, “Yes.” He said: “If you were to visit the graves of your fathers and mothers, you would not do that.”
He said: I said, “Then what thing should we eat?” He said: “Bread with milk.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbd Allāh, referring here to Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام
key_terms.سُفْرَةً: provisions or a food spread prepared for a journey

ai.seo_question: What food is recommended when visiting the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches restraint and simplicity when visiting the grave of Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام discourages treating such a visit like an outing with elaborate provisions and instead directs the visitor toward modest food.
